LanguageData.INH_DelegatedEnable: Enable delegated site registration and storage
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedEnableHint: Register a stopped player caravan's current location and store original colonists or animals while leaving a human escort. Existing returns and unfinished operations remain available when disabled. Storage stays frozen; maintenance handles food accounting only.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedCustodyHelp: Register a site at a stopped player caravan's current location. Store original colonists or animals individually, keep a human escort in the caravan, and return stored occupants to that same original caravan.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedFrozenWarning: Frozen storage and food accounting only. Stored colonists and animals' ordinary hunger, health, aging and production do not progress; daily life is not simulated.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedReadUnavailable: The site or original caravan could not be read. Check the game state and reopen this screen.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedChooseSite: Choose a site or register a new one
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedNoCaravans: No player caravan is available. Stop a caravan at the intended location.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedRegisterHelp: To register a new site, choose a stopped caravan and enter a name. Existing maps, settlements and registered sites cannot be replaced.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedDisabled: Enable delegated storage in the mod settings to register a site or store more occupants. Existing returns and unfinished operations remain available.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedNoCandidates: Choose a located site and a caravan to inspect its colonists and animals.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedNoResidents: No occupants are stored at the selected site.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedNoPending: No operations are waiting for completion at this site.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_Disabled: New registration and storage are disabled. Existing returns and recovery remain available.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_Unlocated: This older site has no registered world location. Choose or register a located site.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_CaravanMissing: The original caravan is missing. Stored originals cannot be returned to a replacement caravan.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_CaravanMoving: The caravan must stop before this operation.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_CaravanAway: The original caravan must be stopped at this site's location.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_Occupied: This location already contains a map, settlement or registered site.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_NoEscort: Keep at least one eligible human escort in the original caravan.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_Ineligible: This original is not ready. Check health, drafting and who owns the caravan.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_Reserved: The original is reserved for another transport or operation.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_PendingCustody: Retry the existing unfinished storage or return operation first.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_PendingRations: Recover the unfinished food charge from the maintenance screen first.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_Unknown: This operation needs attention. Check the original caravan and occupant.
LanguageData.INH_DelegatedProblem_CityLocked: Another unfinished operation is using this site. Recover that operation before moving occupants.
